{{Draft}}
Every field of the [[Objects]] forms, in the order of the form. Field names are given as they appear in the forms; where a field appears under another name in some forms, that name is given in brackets. Fields filled in automatically (who created or changed an entry, and when) are not listed.

'''Input:''' ''text'', ''number'', ''tick box'', ''list'' (choose from a fixed list) or a link to another record. '''Required''' fields must be filled in before saving. Long lists are shown on the [[Field reference/Base tables|Base tables]] page.

== Main form ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Artist'''<br /><small>(not in the forms)</small> || The artist whose catalogue the artwork belongs to. Set automatically when the artwork is created in the artist's catalogue. || link to an artist || 
|-
| '''Record type''' || "main data" for the artwork itself. "correction data" or "supplementary data" for an additional record that corrects or supplements another artwork's data; such records never appear as artworks of their own. || list || main data, correction data, supplementary data
|-
| '''Parent object''' || For correction or supplementary data: the artwork (main data) this record belongs to. Leave empty for normal artworks. Not used for suites. || link to an artwork || 
|-
| '''Internal reference''' || The artwork's number in the catalogue raisonné, or another stable reference. Searchable and shown prominently; use one consistent scheme. || text || 
|-
| '''Has title ?''' || Tick if the work has a title. Untick for untitled works: the catalogue then shows "No title", and Title should stay empty. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Title''' || The main title of the work, in the catalogue's main language. Further titles go into the Titles section. || text || 
|-
| '''Object type''' || What kind of work it is. Decides which of the fields for prints, sculptures or unique works apply. || list<br />'''required''' || Painting, Print, Sculpture, Drawing, Multimedia, Photography, Audio, Watercolour, Other, Happening, Book, Text, Installation, Work on paper, Lithography, Etching, Serigraphy, Linocut, Woodcut, Multiple, Digital print, Poster, Draft, Monotype, Colour Drawing
|-
| '''StatusWeb''' || Editorial status of the artwork for the website, for teams that track review steps. It does not show or hide anything; only Public does. || list || Not ready for publication, Ready for publication, Approved for publication, NOT approved for publication, Requieres verification
|-
| '''StatusPrint''' || Editorial status of the artwork for the printed catalogue raisonné, for teams that track review steps. || list || Not ready for publication, Ready for publication, Approved for publication, NOT approved for publication, Requieres verification
|-
| '''Public''' || Tick to publish the artwork. As long as it is unticked, only editors see it. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Is it a Suite ?''' || Tick if this record is a suite: a series of separately catalogued works, such as a portfolio of prints. The members point to it with "ID parent suite". || tick box || 
|-
| '''All Grouping ID'''<br /><small>(Type of grouping)</small> || Groups works together in the layout of a printed catalogue (suite, folder, installation, group, book). Has no further meaning. || list || Suite, Folder, Installation, Group, Book
|-
| '''ID parent suite''' || For a member of a suite: the suite it belongs to. || link to an artwork || 
|-
| '''Secuential number in suite''' || For a member of a suite: its position in the series, for example 3 for the third of twelve sheets. || number || 
|-
| '''Creation date (day)''' || Day of creation (1 to 31), if known. || number || 
|-
| '''Creation month''' || Month of creation, if known. || list || January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
|-
| '''Year creation''' || Year of creation. For a period of several years: the last year. || number || 
|-
| '''All Creation Year From''' || For a period of several years: the first year. Leave empty for a single year. || number || 
|-
| '''All CreationDateQualifierID'''<br /><small>(Qualifier of creation date)</small> || How certain the creation date is, for example approximate, before or after. Use it instead of leaving the date empty. || list || approximate, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, earliest, after, before, at latest, unverified, unlimited, in part
|-
| '''Notes''' || Internal notes for editors. Never published; notes for readers go into the Notes section. || long text || 
|-
| '''Location of creation''' || Place where the work was made. || text || 
|-
| '''All Creation Country'''<br /><small>(Country of creation)</small> || Country where the work was made. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
|-
| '''Print PaperID'''<br /><small>(Used print paper)</small> || For prints: the paper. An edition can record a different paper. || list || 119 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Print papers|Print papers]]
|-
| '''Watermark''' || For prints: the watermark of the paper. || list || 46 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Watermarks|Watermarks]]
|-
| '''Paper weight''' || For prints: weight of the paper in grams per square metre. || number || 
|-
| '''No. o fused plates''' || For prints: how many plates, stones or blocks were used. || number || 
|-
| '''No of used colours''' || For prints: how many colours were printed. || number || 
|-
| '''Print Tirage'''<br /><small>(Total number of prints)</small> || For prints: the total print run as known. Text, so it can include remarks. || text || 
|-
| '''Print TirageQualifierID'''<br /><small>(Qualifier for total number of prints)</small> || How certain the print run is: approximate, estimate, minimum, maximum, exact and so on. || list || approximate, sight, maximum, largest, smallest, average, variable, assembled, before restoration, at corners, rounded, framed, with base, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, some, many, irregular, few, visible, unverified, unlimited, in part
|-
| '''Sculpture: Material''' || Intended for the material of a sculpture, but the field currently accepts only a number. Record the material in the Components section. || number || 
|-
| '''Sculpture: Material of model''' || Intended for the material of the sculpture's model, but the field currently accepts only a number. Record it in the Components section or the notes. || number || 
|-
| '''Sculpture: Model exists''' || For sculptures: tick if the model still exists. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Sculpture: is multiple (Y/N)''' || For sculptures: tick if the work is a multiple rather than a unique piece. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Present location''' || For unique works: where the work is now (city or institution). || text || 
|-
| '''Unique PresentLocationCountryID'''<br /><small>(Current Location of object)</small> || For unique works: the country where the work is now. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
|-
| '''Conservation State''' || For unique works: the state of conservation, such as condition and restorations. || text || 
|-
| '''Comments''' || Internal comments for editors. Not published. || text || 
|-
| '''Lido Record Id'''<br /><small>(ID of the LIDO record)</small> || Identifier of the record in the LIDO file the artwork was imported from (LIDO is a data exchange format for museum objects). Filled by imports. || text || 
|-
| '''Lido Source'''<br /><small>(Source of the LIDO record)</small> || Source of the LIDO record the artwork was imported from. Filled by imports. || text || 
|}

== Notes ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Edition'''<br /><small>(not in the forms)</small> || Limits the entry to one print edition. Leave empty when it applies to the whole work. || link to a print edition || 
|-
| '''Sculpture edition'''<br /><small>(not in the forms)</small> || Limits the entry to one sculpture edition. Leave empty when it applies to the whole work. || link to a sculpture edition || 
|-
| '''Part'''<br /><small>(not in the forms)</small> || Limits the entry to one part of the work. Leave empty when it applies to the whole work. || link to a part of the artwork || 
|-
| '''Language'''<br /><small>(Language ID)</small> || Language of the note; one entry per language. || list<br />'''required''' || German, English, French, Italian, Spanish
|-
| '''Description''' || Heading of the note, for example "Inscription". || text || 
|-
| '''Notes''' || The text of the note, as published. || long text || 
|}

|-

|-
| '''Begin date (month)'''<br /><small>(From (month); Begin Date Month)</small> || Start date, as far as known. || list || January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
|-
| '''Begin date (year)'''<br /><small>(From (year); Begin Date Year)</small> || Start date, as far as known. || number || 
|-
| '''Qualifier for start date'''<br /><small>(Begin Date Qualifier)</small> || How certain the start date is. || list || approximate, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, earliest, after, before, at latest, unverified, unlimited, in part

| '''End date (day)'''<br /><small>(Until date (day); End Date Day)</small> || End date; the same as the start date for a single day. || number || 
|-

|-
| '''End date (year)'''<br /><small>(Until date (year); End Date Year)</small> || End date; the same as the start date for a single day. || number<br />'''required''' || 
|-
| '''Qualifier for end date'''<br /><small>(End Date Qualifier)</small> || How certain the end date is. || list || approximate, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, earliest, after, before, at latest, unverified, unlimited, in part
|-
| '''City''' || City where it took place. || text || 
|-
| '''Country'''<br /><small>(Country ID)</small> || Country where it took place. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
